run_dns_server_for_lb_tests: run a DNS server for gRPC load balancer interop tests with specified balancer and fallback IPs
generate_dns_records_config: generate a YAML DNS records config file with SRV and A records for load balancer testing
test_no_error_no_data_response: test the DNS NOERROR response with no ANSWER section case by using the cause no error flag
configure_balancer_a_records: configure DNS A records for gRPC load balancer IPs with a TTL of 2100 seconds
configure_fallback_a_records: configure DNS A records for gRPC fallback server IPs with a TTL of 2100 seconds
